title: A Visit to Masato

nodes.speaker: Masato Shima
nodes.text: Do you know why we first took residence in the Sewers?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Do you know why we first took residence in the Sewers?

nodes.speaker: Masato Shima
nodes.text: Abandoned it once we learned how to tame the weather's witches. Shameful.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Abandoned it once we learned how to tame the weather's witches. Shameful.

nodes.speaker: Masato Shima
nodes.text: Indeed. I take it you're here because you handled your first task to completion?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Indeed. I take it you're here because you handled your first task to completion?

nodes.speaker: Masato Shima
nodes.text: I see. That's interesting because I didn't send you to talk with Mizzy. I sent you to get Lims from Mizzy.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I see. That's interesting because I didn't send you to talk with Mizzy. I sent you to get Lims from Mizzy.

nodes.speaker: Masato Shima
nodes.text: One must find... opportunities... where one must. You should know something about that. I assume you're here because you took the opportunity I so generously gave you?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: One must find... opportunities... where one must. You should know something about that. I assume you're here because you took the opportunity I so generously gave you?

nodes.speaker: Masato Shima
nodes.text: There is no debating with a scorpion. When you are stung you are dead.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: There is no debating with a scorpion. When you are stung you are dead.

nodes.speaker: Masato Shima
nodes.text: And what excuse did she give you? Did the Boards tell her not to pay? Were her trains running too smoothly to get a good wager?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And what excuse did she give you? Did the Boards tell her not to pay? Were her trains running too smoothly to get a good wager?

nodes.speaker: Masato Shima
nodes.text: Don't be sorry, do better. Apologists are pathetic scum.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Don't be sorry, do better. Apologists are pathetic scum.

nodes.speaker: Masato Shima
nodes.text: And let me assume that you gave her such an extension?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And let me assume that you gave her such an extension?

nodes.speaker: Masato Shima
nodes.text: You live a dangerous life. I expect to see you in three days time with the Lims Mizzy owes me plus ten percent.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You live a dangerous life. I expect to see you in three days time with the Lims Mizzy owes me plus ten percent.

nodes.speaker: Masato Shima
nodes.text: I'm aware. Tick tock my little restauranteur.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm aware. Tick tock my little restauranteur.

nodes.speaker: Masato Shima
nodes.text: I would not have trusted you with such a task should I thought you would have acted otherwise. You are most welcome in this place.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I would not have trusted you with such a task should I thought you would have acted otherwise. You are most welcome in this place.

nodes.speaker: Masato Shima
nodes.text: Alexandria is paying our friend a visit. Go ahead and catch up with her. I'll be in touch soon.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Alexandria is paying our friend a visit. Go ahead and catch up with her. I'll be in touch soon.

nodes.speaker: Masato Shima
nodes.text: Because we were afraid of the storms in the sky. So we hid. Built a waterfront oasis meant for our survival. And what did we do?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Because we were afraid of the storms in the sky. So we hid. Built a waterfront oasis meant for our survival. And what did we do?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: No.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Agreed.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Agreed.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Seems to suit you just fine though.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Seems to suit you just fine though.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Seems to suit you just fine though.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Seems to suit you just fine though.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I talked with Mizzy.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I talked with Mizzy.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Debatable.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Debatable.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: She didn't have them.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: She didn't have them.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: She said she needed three days.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: She said she needed three days.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: She said she needed three days.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: She said she needed three days.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sorry.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sorry.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I did.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I did.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You will.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You will.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Ten percent? You're crazy.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ten percent? You're crazy.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I did not.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I did not.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So what now?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So what now?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Thanks?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Thanks?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm sure you will tell me now.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm sure you will tell me now.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'm sure you will tell me now.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'm sure you will tell me now.
